description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1738/32 of 29.12.2011 by Anamaduwa D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for public purposes under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and location details) and outlines the legal process for acquisition, including notice requirements and compensation claims. This fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition, property descriptions, and land-related legal procedures.
